svg.title: Step 9 mockup 07: a tournament session on the screens
svg.text: 07 · A tournament session on the screens, from registration to the champion
The tournament emits (step 7); Screen draws the boxes and Moments the called match and the champion. Check-in shows only where the organiser turned it on (0027).
Use case: players and the hall follow a heat; the crew runs it from the tournament's own pages.
Session events feed the hero (its game and cover) and the next box;
checkin_qr with the session's purpose while
tournament.checkin.opened is open; counts from the events.
Moments' match called (built in step 4) with the voice room's name
▲1 and ▼1 for 60 s; a correction does it quietly (E7).
The final's result: Moments' champion story; the standings frame
